caption: The drawing consists of two separate illustrations on a single sheet, each framed by a rectangular outline. The top illustration depicts a metallic key, shown in a horizontal orientation and labeled "KEY. EXACT SIZE." The key is rendered in shades of grey and silver, with detailing to indicate a metallic texture. It features an oval-shaped bow (handle), a cylindrical shaft with a single decorative groove, and a bit with intricate, angular cutouts. The bottom illustration shows a lock, labeled "LOCK. HALF SIZE." The lock is rectangular and drawn in a horizontal orientation, with a wooden central section in brown tones and end plates colored in dark grey to suggest metal. The wood grain is visible, and the lock has four corner plates, each secured by two round-headed screws, and a keyhole at the center, outlined in black and white. Both objects are centered within their respective outlined boxes, and the background is a plain, light beige, with handwritten labels beneath each drawing.
title: Key and Lock
